title: The Summoner becomes the Lord of the Void
changes: Your golems are now permanent: one from level 1, a second from level 18 with Twin Bond. They climb back out of the Void 12 seconds after falling, and each one wraps you in the aura of its element. Existing Summoners get all their skill points back for free.

New skill tree in three branches (Golems, Void, Conjuration): Black Hole swallows monsters and enemy projectiles, Void Slip saves you at low life, elemental wisps and Void Blades fight beside you, and three new ultimates (Colossus, Event Horizon, Void Arsenal) spend your Void Essence.
Your staff bolt now goes through a Void portal: longer reach, and it comes out right next to your target. The third hit of the combo bursts on the foes around it.
Some new effects still use temporary looks; their own art comes in a later update.
